roadmap.title: Settle in and start daily routines
roadmap.description: Meet your neighbors, repair the bridge, and begin the town projects. Donate new finds as you collect them. Start birthday gifts, crop work, and animal care early. Save a separate file with the farmhouse diary before catching legendary fish.

roadmap.title: Open the woods and build relationships
roadmap.description: Work through the mine seals and town repairs together. Build friendship with Juniper and Eiland for the later mine quests. Choose Best Friends with one candidate and Dating with a different candidate. Keep a diary save before either eight-heart event.

roadmap.title: Finish the main projects and start a family
roadmap.description: Finish the Mines, later town upgrades, and house expansion. Marry and start a family as soon as you are ready so the child's first-year timer runs while you finish skills, breeding, and collections.

roadmap.title: Finish seasonal collections and long goals
roadmap.description: Complete every Museum set and Stillwell mission. Reach level 60 in all skills and purchase one Tier 5 perk per skill. Continue birthday gifts and play until your child's first birthday; missed seasonal events return the following year.

achievements.summary: Finish Adeline's first food-reserve project.

steps.text: Read Adeline's letter and meet her at the Manor House for @mechanic{Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves}.

achievements.summary: Restore Mistria's mill.

steps.text: Read the letter for @mechanic{The Mill Restoration Project} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.

achievements.summary: Finish the General Store renovation.

steps.text: Read the letter for @mechanic{Repair the General Store} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.
Fill the donation box by @loc{the General Store} with 5 Iron Ingots, 5 Copper Ingots, 300 Wood, 500 Stone.

achievements.summary: Restore the bridge at the Beach.

steps.text: Read the letter for @mechanic{Repair the Beach Bridge} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.

achievements.summary: Finish Adeline's second food-reserve project.

Speak to @npc{Adeline} after filling the donation box to complete the project.

achievements.summary: Complete the renovation of Hayden's barn and coop.

steps.text: Read the letter for @mechanic{Upgrade Hayden's Barn} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.
Put 400 Wood, 500 Stone, and 8 Iron Ingots in the donation box by @loc{Hayden's barn}.
Bring 4,000 tesserae to @npc{Adeline} to finish the project.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Mistmare mount.

steps.text: After upgrading Hayden's barn, wait for the next day's windstorm and take @npc{Hayden}'s @mechanic{Find the Weathervane} quest.
Find the weathervane in the western Narrows. Offer @mechanic{100 essence} at the Horse Statue there to unlock the Mistmare.

achievements.summary: Finish renovating the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

steps.text: Read the letter for @mechanic{Upgrade the Inn} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.
Put 10 Silver Ingots, 500 Stone, 25 Glass, 600 Wood, and 10 Peat in the donation box by @loc{the Inn}.
Bring 6,000 tesserae to @npc{Adeline} to finish the project.

achievements.summary: Build the Stone Refinery.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{Town Rank 50}. Read the letter for @mechanic{Stone Refinery} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.

Bring 5,000 tesserae to @npc{Adeline} to finish the project.

Speak to @npc{Adeline} after filling the donation box to complete the project.

achievements.summary: Finish renovating the Carpenter's Shop.

achievements.description: Add two more new vendors to the Saturday Market
achievements.summary: Bring the final two additional vendors to the Saturday Market.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{Town Rank 80}. Read the letter for @mechanic{Expanding the Saturday Market} and attend the meeting marked by the quest.
Fill the donation box by @loc{the plaza west of the Blacksmith} with 5 Monster Blocks, 10 Monster Cores, 5 Mistril Ingots, 20 Refined Stone, 50 Voidite.
Speak to @npc{Adeline} after filling the donation box to complete the project.

achievements.summary: Finish restoring Mistria's Bell Tower.

steps.text: After expanding the market, greet Stillwell and Zorel on Saturday and report to Nora. Once Town Rank reaches 90, read Zorel's letter and join the meeting at the Bell Tower.

Reach @mechanic{Blacksmithing level 30}. Complete The Dragonsworn Tablet at floor 100 to unlock the material recipes. At the floor-90 Dragon Forge, make a Fang using 1 Medium Essence Stone, 1 Written Root, 5 Void Herb, 5 Void Stone, and 5 Monster Fangs. For a Core, use 1 Medium Essence Stone, 1 Ancient Firefly, 1 Pink Diamond, 1 Mistril Ingot, and 5 Monster Cores.
Put 20 Refined Stone, 30 Hardwood, 1 Dragon-Forged Fang, and 1 Dragon-Forged Core in the donation box by @loc{the Bell Tower}.
Speak to @npc{Adeline} after filling the donation box to complete the project.

achievements.summary: Open the Water Seal in the Mines.

guide.context: The offering items come from the Upper Mines, floors 1–19.

steps.text: On or after Spring 6, meet Eiland at the Museum for The State of the Mines. At Town Rank 10, follow Errol's letter and meet him and Eiland at the Mines entrance.
Reach @loc{Mines floor 20} and take the tablet to @npc{Eiland} for translation.
Gather one each of Stone Loach, Upper Mines Mushroom, Ruby, and Lantern Moth. Offer the items at the @mechanic{Water Seal} on floor 20.

achievements.summary: Open the Earth Seal in the Mines.

guide.context: The offering items come from the Tide Caverns, floors 21–39.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Mines floor 40} and take the tablet to @npc{Juniper} for translation.
Gather one each of Coral Mantis, Sapphire, Archerfish, and Jade Dulse. Offer the items at the @mechanic{Earth Seal} on floor 40.

achievements.summary: Open the Fire Seal in the Mines.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Mines floor 60} and take the tablet to @npc{Juniper} for translation.

For @mechanic{Procuring the Sealing Scroll}, wait for Balor's letter and meet him in his room. Put 10 Rubies, 10 Sapphires, 10 Emeralds, and 10 Silver Ingots in the chest beside his wagon to receive the scroll.
Gather one each of Faceted Rock Gem, Rockroot, Emerald, and Sealing Scroll. Offer the items at the @mechanic{Fire Seal} on floor 60.

achievements.summary: Open the Ruins Seal in the Mines.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Mines floor 80} and speak to @npc{the Priestess}.
Follow the Priestess through the portal to receive @mechanic{Void Sight}. Mine Void Stone nodes, defeat monsters for Void Powder, gather Void Herb, and fish for Void Pearls. Collect five of each.

Find the cauldron inside the Void Seal room. Add 5 Void Pearls, 5 Void Herb, 5 Void Powder, and 5 Void Stone. Return with the Priestess and the new decoy. Tell the decoy to take a rubbing of the Ruins Seal Tablet so you can read the offering requirements.
Collect 1 Obsidian, 1 Firesail Fish, 1 Smoke Moth, and 1 Breath of Flame in the Lava Caves. Give these offerings to your @npc{Void decoy} on floor 80 so the decoy opens the Ruins Seal.

achievements.description: Use the Magic Key in the Priestess Quarters
achievements.summary: Unlock the sealed door in the Priestess Quarters with the Magic Key.

steps.text: At Mines floor 90, enter the northwest room. Clear its corrupted rocks with @mechanic{Dragon's Breath} and read the clue on the rightmost bookshelf.
In the southwest room, cast Dragon's Breath on the forge to ignite it, then read the library clues.
Gather 1 Temple Flower in the Deep Woods and 1 Marigold during summer. At the tablet in the northeast room, offer both flowers to receive the Seed of Balance.
Plant the @item{Seed of Balance} in the floor-90 Field Room. Water the seed daily for four days, or cast Growth to mature the plant immediately.
Harvest the @item{Magic Key} and use the key on the locked door in the Priestess Quarters.

achievements.summary: Open the Final Seal in the Mines.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Mines floor 100} and inspect the Dragonsworn Tablet. Raise @npc{Juniper} and @npc{Eiland} to eight hearts and view both eight-heart events. Speak to Juniper, then read the tablet again.
Reach @mechanic{Blacksmithing level 30}. Use the floor-90 Dragon Forge to make 1 @item{Dragon-Forged Fang}. Bring 1 Medium Essence Stone, 1 Written Root, 5 Void Herb, 5 Void Stone, 5 Monster Fang.
At the floor-90 Dragon Forge, make 1 @item{Dragon-Forged Horn}. The recipe needs 5 Monster Horn and 1 Medium Essence Stone, plus 5 Void Powder, 1 Void Snail, and 5 Void Pearl.
Use the floor-90 Dragon Forge to make 1 @item{Dragon-Forged Core}. Bring 1 Medium Essence Stone, 1 Ancient Firefly, 1 Pink Diamond, 1 Mistril Ingot, 5 Monster Core.
Use the floor-90 Dragon Forge to make 1 @item{Dragon-Forged Powder}. Bring 1 Medium Essence Stone, 1 Luminescent Crab, 1 Pink Diamond, 1 Mistril Ingot, 5 Monster Powder.
Return to floor 100 with the four Dragon-Forged materials. Place one of each material on the Dragonsworn Tablet to open the seal.

guide.context: Keep a different romance candidate available for dating and marriage. If you choose friendship with your intended spouse, reload your diary save from before the event.

Make a separate save with your farmhouse diary before the eight-heart event. Choose the @mechanic{Best Friends} route during the event.

achievements.summary: Choose the Dating relationship during a romance candidate's eight-heart event.

guide.context: Choosing Best Friends closes that candidate's romance route. Reload the save made before the event if you want to date that candidate.

steps.text: Reach eight hearts with a romance candidate and finish their earlier heart events.
Keep a separate diary save before the eight-heart event. Choose the @mechanic{Dating} route during that event.

achievements.description: Reach ten hearts with a romanceable villager that you are dating.
achievements.summary: Reach ten hearts with a romance candidate you are dating.

steps.text: After choosing Dating at the eight-heart event, keep talking to your partner and giving liked or loved gifts until the relationship reaches ten hearts.

achievements.summary: Complete a wedding with your chosen partner.

steps.text: Reach ten hearts with a partner you are dating. Get the Engagement Ring recipe from Elsie the next day.
Reach Blacksmithing level 30. Complete @mechanic{The Dragonsworn Tablet} at Mines floor 100 by viewing Juniper's and Eiland's eight-heart events, speaking to Juniper, and reading the tablet again.
Make a Dragon-Forged Core at the floor-90 Dragon Forge. The recipe uses 1 Medium Essence Stone, 1 Ancient Firefly, 1 Pink Diamond, 1 Mistril Ingot, and 5 Monster Cores.
At an anvil, make the Engagement Ring with 1 Dragon-Forged Core, 4 Gold Ingots, 4 Mistril Ingots, and 2 Diamonds.
Hold the ring near your partner and select @mechanic{Discuss}. Propose, choose a wedding date at least five days away, and play through the wedding.

achievements.summary: Welcome a child into your family.

steps.text: Two weeks after your wedding, go to bed to receive the Great Bird dream and the @item{Mystical Feather}.
Hold the feather near your spouse and choose @mechanic{Discuss}. Agree to start a family, then go to bed for the next dream and choose a delivery option.
Play until the due date marked on the calendar, two weeks after the second dream.

achievements.summary: Reach your child's first birthday.

achievements.summary: Produce a Tier 5 animal through breeding.

steps.text: Keep an adult male and female of the same species in one barn or coop, with an empty slot for the baby.
Buy the matching Heart Shaped animal treats from Hayden. Give a treat to each parent on the same day; a stork icon confirms breeding. The baby arrives four days later.
Start with a pair of Tier 1 animals. Raise two Tier 2 offspring to adulthood and breed them together; do the same with a Tier 3 pair, then a Tier 4 pair to produce Tier 5.

guide.context: Spend 80 essence on the level-30 @mechanic{Legendary} Fishing perk at Caldarus' shrine. Donate the four fish to the Museum. Each legendary fish can be caught only once per save. achievements.displayName: From a House to a Home
achievements.summary: Purchase all four farmhouse size upgrades.

steps.text: At the @loc{Carpenter's Shop}, buy Home Upgrade 1 with 500 Wood, 500 Stone, and 5,000 tesserae.
Buy Home Upgrade 2 with 500 Wood, 500 Stone, 20 Iron Ingots, and 15,000 tesserae.
